name: Smarten Power Systems Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2014, Smarten Power Systems Limited is in the business of designing and assembling of power back-up and advanced solar power products, and trading of solar panels and batteries[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
SPSL is engaged in the design and assembly 
of power backup and advanced solar energy products. It provides efficient and low-cost 
power solutions by assembling and trading various products viz.:
a) Home UPS systems
b) Solar inverters
c) Solar power conditioning units (PCUs)
d) Solar charge controllers
Additionally, the company is involved in the trading of:
a) Solar panels (domestic only)
b) Batteries

pros: Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 45.8%
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Promoter holding has decreased over last quarter: -24.6%
